_note: MASWALI-DESIGN-R2 draft strings for the Millionea product. Keys are identical across en / sw / zh. Every number, rate, date, time, serial and count that is data is a {placeholder}; money is written "TZS\u00a0{amount}"; the weekly close is {closeAt} and the sales open {salesOpen} (the canvases show the sample week's Friday 18:00 EAT). The rules that are not data (15 questions, 10 main, 5 reserve, 10/10, 13% fee, cap 10, 5 minutes, 24 hours) are written out. sw and zh are DRAFTS and need native review; final strings belong to the dictionary (src/lib/i18n-dict.ts). No question text is here: questions are data. No legal claim is here.
